visible.author: Surf70
visible.title: Awesome Tire for my 2020 Trail Boss
visible.body: I bought the stock size tire for my 2020 Trail boss with 18-inch stock wheels. I tell you these tires are quiet and grip. These tires are by far the best I have ever had. Compared to the Dura Trac stock tires they are super quiet, and the traction is by far superior. We had a snowstorm here in Illinois and had about 4 inches still on the road before the plows started. I did not even have to put my truck in 4-wheel drive, these tires just cut right through to snow, and I never lost traction. Buy these for your truck! Yes, they are a little pricey, but you get what you pay for.
